name: Gachi de Itsudemo Hatsujouchuu ~Mannen Hatsujouki de Sakarippanashi na Usamimi Musume no Mendou o Miru Koto ni Narimashita~
original_name: ガチで・いつでも・発情中～万年発情期でサカリっぱなしなウサ耳娘の面倒をみることになりました～
source:
You know how rabbits are always horny?
Well, you've just gotten yourself a new rabbit (a rabbit girl, really) from your friend.
She looks quite sweet and innocent, but she's still a rabbit, after all -- so she's always ready to hop into bed!

[From DLsite English]
translation:
你听说过兔子总是处于发情期吗？
这不，你刚从朋友那里领养了一只新兔子（准确来说，是一只兔耳娘）。
她看起来乖巧甜美、天真无邪，但归根结底还是一只兔子——因此无论何时何地，她都随时准备蹦上你的床！

[摘自DLsite英文版]
